cell_1: Historical source: December 2024 SAFE, Executive Summary, Tier 3 version, p. 4; B40% is printed in section 7.2, p. 35.

2027--2028 projections assume catch of 1,375,000 t in each year, mean 2023--2025 selectivity and fixed biological inputs. Total biomass covers ages 3+ at the start of the year. F_OFL and maximum F_ABC are the fully selected F35% and F40% rates. Biomass and catch are rounded to the nearest 1,000 t.

Spawning biomass exceeds B40% in both years, placing the stock in Tier 3a. All risk categories are Level 1, supporting the maximum ABC. Recruitment is fixed at the fitted 1978--2023 mean; these projections show point estimates. Adopted catch specifications are reported separately.
